Sample.evidence_source: At posttesting, 7 of 9 subjects (78%) in the S-C condition, 6 of 10 subjects (60~ in the BPS condition, and 1 of 9 subjects (11%) in the WL condition had scores below 13.

IPT.evidence_source: Subjects in both treatments endorsed a significantly reduced level of depressive symptomatology on the CDI and CDS. Subjects in the WL condition endorsed significantly less depressive symptomatology on the CDS whxle the reduction reported on the CDI was nonsignificant. On the CDRS-R, subjects from both treatments reported significantly less depressive symptomatology. The difference for subjects in the WL condition was nonsignificant
